# Wealth Arrays

> Wealth Arrays is a browser-first financial calculator and financial education website. It offers transparent formulas, editable assumptions, worked examples, comparison tools and practical money guides. Results are educational estimates, not personalized financial, tax, legal or investment advice.

- https://wealtharrays.com/ — Homepage and calculator discovery

## Editorial principles

- Prefer transparent mathematics over black-box financial claims.
- Distinguish assumptions from live market data; calculator inputs are not automatically verified rates.
- Explain methodology, limitations, and the effects of changing assumptions.
- Encourage users to verify current rates, fees, tax rules, lender conditions and local charges with authoritative providers.
- Do not present scenario outputs as guaranteed returns or personalized financial advice.
- Core calculators are designed to calculate in the browser; users should not enter sensitive personal or financial information into a public website.
